# AGENTS.md — working in this repo

AgentReady.js: a zero-dependency browser drop-in (Bun + TypeScript 7 strict) that turns
semantic HTML into WebMCP tools. Safety model is the product: read `README.md`'s
"Safety model" section before touching `src/policy.ts`, `src/semantic.ts`,
`src/tools/`, or `src/inspector.ts`.

## Generated files — do not hand-edit

These are git-tracked build artifacts, regenerated by `bun run build` (+ `bun run build:min`):
- `dist/agentready.js`, `dist/agentready.min.js` (the shippable bundles)
- `demo/store/vendor/agentready.js` (bundle copy used by the demo store)
- `demo/store/app.js`, `demo/test-page/status.js` (compiled from their `.ts` siblings)

Rule: after editing anything under `src/` or `demo/**/*.ts`, run `bun run build` (and
`build:min` when the min bundle exists in your change) and commit the regenerated
artifacts in the SAME commit as the source change. CI fails if committed artifacts
don't match a fresh build. Gitignored: `build/`, `dist/*.d.ts`.

## Commands

- `bun install` — deps (Bun only; npm/yarn lockfiles are not maintained)
- `bun run typecheck` — strict tsc, covers src/demo/tests/scripts
- `bun run lint` / `bun run format` — Biome check / format
- `bun test tests/agentready.test.ts` — unit tests (happy-dom; fast)
- `bun run build && bun test tests/e2e` — E2E (Playwright; real Chrome preferred, bundled Chromium fallback)
- `bun run size` — bundle budget gate (75 KB raw / 45 KB min)
- `make ci` — full local gate (typecheck → lint → types → build → min → unit → size → e2e)
- `bun run demo` / `make demo` — dev server at :8788 (`make demo PORT=…` overrides)

## Conventions

- TypeScript strict everywhere; no `any` in `src/` (tests may stub loosely).
- Unit tests: `tests/agentready.test.ts`, bun:test + happy-dom, `mount()`/`makeEnv()` helpers; add to a topical `describe` block.
- Registration/log failures: `console.warn('[AgentReady] …')`, never throw out of boot.
- Safety refusals: human-readable strings starting with `Refused:`.
- Commits: conventional (`fix(policy): …`, `docs: …`, `test: …`).
- `video/` is a separate package (own lockfile + lint config) — root configs don't apply there.

## Safety-sensitive files

Changes to `src/policy.ts` (classification regexes/levels), `src/semantic.ts` (discovery +
redaction), `src/inspector.ts` (human approval gate), and `src/tools/**` require matching
unit tests asserting both the refused and allowed cases. The README "Safety model" table
is the contract; the test suite (`tests/agentready.test.ts`) pins its guarantees.
